home.tip1: Scan in time to keep production progress accurate and ease later payroll settlement.
home.tip2: Take photos of failed quality checks for later repair tracing.
home.tip3: Print bundle numbers right after cutting to avoid mixing up later processes.
home.tip4: Scan materials into stock as soon as they arrive to keep inventory real-time.
home.tip5: Notify operators after changing process unit prices to avoid wage discrepancies.
home.tip6: Prioritize orders nearing their deadline — delays hurt customer satisfaction.
home.tip7: Re-inspect and scan after rework; only qualified items may go into stock.
home.tip8: Scan to confirm as soon as each process is done, for easier progress tracking.
home.tip9: Complete the material list during sample development — it drives purchase accuracy.
home.tip10: Check color, size and quantity before shipping to avoid wrong shipments and returns.
